query:
Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
# Simple workflow for deploying static content to GitHub Pages
name: Deploy static content to Pages

on:
  # Runs on pushes targeting the default branch
  push:
    branches: ["master"]

  # Allows you to run this workflow manually from the Actions tab
  workflow_dispatch:

# Sets permissions of the GITHUB_TOKEN to allow deployment to GitHub Pages
permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

# Allow one concurrent deployment
concurrency:
  group: "pages"
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # Single deploy job since we're just deploying
  deploy:
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Build page
        run: ./web/build.sh
      - name: Setup Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3.0.1
        with:
          # Upload entire repository
          path: 'web'
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4.0.5

Cancel superseded runs

Pattern: P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE (stale_run_cancellation)

When is cancel superseded runs applicable?

Assess cancel superseded runs for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: Runs represent the same workflow and branch or PR; A newer revision supersedes older checks

Contraindications: Release or deployment work; Distinct branches share a cancellation group

Method: Partition cancellation by workflow and branch/PR; Preserve run identity and audit records

Reported finding: Superseding runs can reduce duplicate work.

Pause repeatedly failing scheduled workflows

Pattern: P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE (failing_schedule_suppression)

When is pause repeatedly failing scheduled workflows applicable?

Assess pause repeatedly failing scheduled workflows for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: A monitored pause/resume policy is approved

Contraindications: Continuous monitoring or periodic checks are mandatory

Method: Notify the owner when pausing; Define an explicit recovery and reactivation path

Reported finding: Failure-streak suppression offers estimated savings.

Reported metrics: {"consecutive_failure_threshold": 3, "paid_total_vm_time_reduction_percent": 3.2}

Source: Resource Usage and Optimization Opportunities in Workflows of GitHub Actions (2024), 4.3.1; Tables 5-6; PDF pp. 8, 9: https://software-lab.org/publications/icse2024_workflows.pdf
